mapper.insert: INSERT INTO batch_metadata (job_name, last_processed_at, updated_at, last_processed_id) VALUES (#{jobName}, #{lastTimeSeconds}, now(), #{lastProcessedId}) ON CONFLICT (job_name) DO UPDATE SET last_processed_at = EXCLUDED.last_processed_at, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at, last_processed_id = EXCLUDED.last_processed_id

INSERT INTO batch_metadata_test (job_name, last_processed_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{jobName}, #{lastTimeSeconds}, now()) ON CONFLICT (job_name) DO UPDATE SET last_processed_at = EXCLUDED.last_processed_at, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
